text:
Super Bowl Lix is ​​finally behind us: all beers have been scattered and Light posts conquered – Which we can start the long look at Super Bowl LX.
A NFL team can now feel legitimately great about its situation (after the hangover clears), while the other 31 are looking for answers and updates.
Today, our mission is to mark the players who will define the low season 2025 in fantasy football. The exploration harvester is just two weeks and the free agency opens in just one month, so we actually have very little time to consider the arrangement of the pieces on the board before they move.
We need to start, of course, with a free pending agent receptor capable of having a seismic impact if you move …
Tee Higgins Higgins is the best individual needle movement of the low season in terms of other people’s fantasy value. If you return to Cincinnati – how could it be your favorite scenario -Then Joe Burrow is a fantasy QB enclosed among the top five with real -life MVP potential. Higgins is the type of physically dominant technician that will raise any offense and field marshal you choose. It is likely that your next QB will jump a level or two after it is in the team.
All the League teams would obviously welcome a career career talent as Higgins, so the offer will be energetic if the Bengals cannot or will not bring it back. Patriots, commanders and loaders are among the receiver teams that are needed with billions in the capitalization space available . It is not difficult to imagine that Higgins lands in a place that effectively guarantees a different workload than anyone who has seen in Cincy. If we are projecting more than 140 goals for this man, it will be classified among the WR1 in fantasy.
Debo Samuel When leaving a seasonal season (which was largely related to health), Samuel requested an exchange of niners and the team has given permission to find new potential houses. It feels as if this relocation is probably happening. Even in a poor season according to its standards, Samuel still handled 93 touches and saw 81 goals; His departure would clearly help keep Jauan Jennings Fantasy and lead to additional opportunities for Ricky Pearsall.
Stylistically, Samuel seems an ideal adjustment for Denver Broncos, a team In search of a multipurpose joker . If Debo is interested and Denver is open to extend it, that movement should occur.
Tyreek Hill Hill seemed to deal with the Super Bowl media week as a apology/retracting tour, saying that almost all the points of sale that spoke that his preference was to remain in Miami. And maybe that’s true. And maybe the dolphins are all in (or mainly) in Tyreek.
Even so, this is a complicated player who turns 31 in a few weeks and was clearly unhappy at the end of the regular season. Let’s not assume that Miami will not hear offers. Hill should be a tempting consolation prize for each team that blows Higgins.
Sam Darnold It is not entirely clear if Darnold is the best bad field shellf and terrible of the most important season of the season. If you return to Minnesota, then the state of Justin Jefferson as a general fantasy selection among the top five is safe, Jordan Addison is a solid WR2 like a rock and Darnold himself is a playable QB with rise.
On the other hand, Darnold lands in a less talent environment, so it is likely to be a field marshal Sol Superflex and Minnesota receptors will be linked to an interesting 22 -year -old pin that leaves multiple knee surgeries. As much as we like the general concept of an offensive directed by JJ McCarthy, it is very unknown at this stage. Darnold, on the other hand, has just produced a 35 touchdown season for a team of 14 wins.
Aaron Rodgers Rodgers is far from the elite at this time of his career, but he is not completely washed. At 41, presumably is still interested in playing professional football, but we know that will not be with the jets.
A massive game of Musical Chairs in Mariscal de Campo is about to take place throughout the league that involves Rodgers, Darnold, Kirk Cousins, Russell Wilson, Jameis Winston and others. When music ends, Rodgers could be somewhere moderately exciting, potentially with steelers or giants, or can land in a less attractive place, such as Titans or Browns. Or it is possible that music stops and Rodgers floats in a sensory deprivation chamber, shaken in the poison of the toad, selfless to continue their career in the NFL. We are dealing with a free spirit here No rise due to traditional paradigms or cultural norms. Shrug .
Davante Adams Adams and Rodgers continue to find the way back, but that is barely guaranteed this low season. After a year in which Adams delivered 1,063 yards and eight touchdowns in 14 games, it will surely attract interest if the jets release it or when. According to the reports, he is looking at the Rams and the Chargers. destinations that would preserve their fantasy value while complicating the projection for Puka Nacua or Ladd McConkey.
Adams is entering its 32 -year -old season, but it’s not close. Each equipment that contains reception needs will at least obtain a price check.
Chris Godwin Recall that when Godwin suffered his ankle injury that ended the season in week 7, it had been a challenge for the general state of WR1 in the year. At that time, it was one of the correct absolute responses in fantasy. We probably should not be too pessimistic about their recovery, because, because He and Bucs were doing noise on a possible return in the postseason If the team made a deep race.
Godwin is entering the free agency at age 29, leaving a half season in which he averaged 82.3 yards for game reception and caught 80.6% of his goals. He has been one of the most reliable players in his position since he entered the League in 2017. A return to Tampa should be of interest to all parties, but would definitely crush much of Jalen McMillan’s recent enthusiasm.
Assuming good health, Godwin is clearly the type of receiver that can raise the fantasy profile of his QB.
Jeanty Ashton Yes, of course, there are some semi -deepe and useful veterans runners that will be available in free agency, but this year’s draft class is definitely No Last year’s draft class. Jeanty is the most likely part that he shake the fantasy draft boards this low season. It doesn’t matter where Aaron Jones or Najee Harris end, we will not consider those guys in the back of the first round.
As for Jeanty … well, maybe.
Jeanty has just delivered one of the best individual seasons in the history of university football, running for an absurd 2,601 yards with an average of 7.0 YPC and reaching the final area 30 times. He also caught 80 passes for 862 yards in three university seasons, so he is fully approved to receive use. If Jeanty finds his way to Dallas, where he mocks commonly, or if he lands in Chicago – where he is literally pleading that he leaves – Then someone in each fantasy draft will point it within the first two rounds of their draft.
Matthew Stafford On the one hand, it makes little obvious sense that the Rams treat a field marshal who has just taken the team to the divisional round, where they gave the eventual Super Bowl champions their toughest test of the playoffs. But perhaps this is a case of a ruthless team that tries to download an aging legend, while its value remains high. There has been too much recent noise about a possible Stafford trade to simply ignore it.
Stafford remains a weapon degree arm talent and one of the most inventive (and also motion) QBs of the game. If it is really a commercial chip, then it is the best option available by 2025. Malik Nabers has already registered interest in the name of the giants.
